title: Cape Romain partnership for coastal protection
citation: Eaton, M.J., Johnson, F.A., Mikels-Carrasco, Jessica, Case, D.J., Martin, Julien, Stith, Bradley, Yurek, Simeon, Udell, Bradley, Villegas, Laura, Taylor, Laura, Haider, Zulquarnain, Charkhgard, Hadi, and Kwon, Changhyun, 2021, Cape Romain partnership for coastal protection: U.S. Geological Survey Open-File Report OF-2021-1021, map scale 1:224,700.
notes: Packet is front matter, introduction and the start of the sea-level-rise chapter of a coastal conservation planning report; no map units, borings, wells, structures or aquifer data. Vertical datum note (NAVD 88, p. 13) is a general report statement, not tied to any geologic value. Only references relevant to South Carolina coastal geology and hydrology are recorded; governance, social-science and general climate references skipped. SUBSURFACE: none.
